title: Tunisian Chicken Tagine
description: A flavorful and aromatic stew from Tunisia, made with tender chicken and a vibrant blend of spices. This dish is perfect for a chilly evening.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large clay or ceramic pot over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger, and cook for another minute.
Add the chicken and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the tunisian spice blend, cumin, coriander, cinnamon, and salt, and stir to combine.
Add the sliced peppers and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
